description: This file contains utility functions for instrumentation, including decorators for wrapping functions and properties with logging, and an attachment function to apply these wrappers to modules, classes, and missing elements. It is part of the Spark project, specifically related to instrumentation utilities.

methods.name: _wrap_function
methods.description: Wraps a function with logging for success and failure, using a threading local flag to prevent re-entrant logging.

methods.name: _wrap_property
methods.description: Wraps a property with logging for get operations, preserving the setter if present.

methods.name: _wrap_missing_function
methods.description: Wraps a missing function to log when it is called, indicating it was missing.

methods.name: _wrap_missing_property
methods.description: Wraps a missing property to log when it is accessed, indicating it was missing.

methods.name: _attach
methods.description: Attaches logging wrappers to specified modules, classes, and missing elements, using a logger obtained from a specified logger module.
